name: create_patient
description: Save a new patient record. Only call this AFTER the caller has explicitly confirmed that all of their collected information is correct during the read-back step. Call it at most once per call.
execution_message_description: Say a brief, natural reassurance that you're saving their information now, e.g. 'Perfect, let me get you registered—one moment.'

date_of_birth.description: Date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format. Must be a real date in the past.

sex.description: Biological sex, exactly one of the allowed values.

address_line_2.description: Optional apartment, suite, or unit number.

preferred_language.description: Optional preferred language. Defaults to English if not provided.

emergency_contact_phone.description: Optional emergency contact US phone number, 10 digits.
